text.aria-label: Subtitle text 'Every scored substation's capacity held at a multiple of the convex model's capacity, everything else refitted (tuning cut, 2024-07-01). The loss has a minimum near the convex capacity, so the data pin the capacity to about 15%.'
text.tspan: Every scored substation's capacity held at a multiple of the convex model's capacity,
everything else refitted (tuning cut, 2024-07-01). The loss has a minimum near the convex
capacity, so the data pin the capacity to about 15%.
